sections.label: SingHealth patient data accessed
sections.summary: Personal particulars and outpatient dispensed medicines of SingHealth's patients were accessed and copied.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Personal particulars and outpatient dispensed medicines of SingHealth’s patients were accessed and copied.

sections.label: SingHealth cyberattack patient numbers
sections.summary: The cyberattack accessed and copied personal particulars of 1.5 million SingHealth patients, with 160,000 having outpatient dispensed medicine information accessed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The cyberattack has resulted in the personal particulars of one-and-a-half million SingHealth patients being accessed and copied.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Of this, 160,000 had information on their outpatient dispensed medicines accessed.

sections.label: Internet surfing separation for SingHealth
sections.summary: Further malicious activity was detected but no further patient data accessed or copied, so Internet surfing separation was effected for SingHealth on 19 July.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Despite the additional cybersecurity measures, we detected further malicious activity on our networks, but no further patient data were accessed or copied.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We decided to effect Internet surfing separation for SingHealth on 19 July to minimise the risk of further intrusion and exfiltration.

sections.label: ISS imposed on public healthcare systems
sections.summary: ISS was temporarily imposed for all public healthcare systems, implemented for SingHealth since 19 July and for NUHS and NHG since 23 July.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: In view of continued malicious activity that we discovered, that we observed, I decided to temporarily impose ISS for all our public healthcare systems.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: ISS was implemented for SingHealth since 19 July, and the National University Health System (NUHS) and National Healthcare Group (NHG) have done so since 23 July.

sections.label: ATP deployment underway
sections.summary: The deployment of ATP had been initiated before this incident and is underway, expected to be completed by end of this month.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The deployment of ATP had been initiated before this incident and is currently underway, expected to be completed by end of this month.

sections.label: Studying ISS as permanent measure
sections.summary: ISS will be studied for its impact on the ground to determine whether it can be kept as a permanent measure for some parts of the healthcare system.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Although I said ISS was a temporary measure, now that it has been implemented, we will study the impact of ISS on the ground and determine whether we can keep it as a permanent measure, at least for some parts of our healthcare system.

sections.label: NEHR independent external review
sections.summary: NEHR will undergo a rigorous independent external review by CSA and PwC Singapore before mandatory contribution of electronic health records proceeds.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Nevertheless, we recognise that this is an important national system of significant scale, as it will eventually house key medical records for all patients.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We will, therefore, put NEHR through a rigorous independent external review before we proceed with the mandatory contribution of electronic health records.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We have engaged CSA and PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) Singapore as independent third parties to help identify any vulnerabilities and recommend measures to address them.

sections.label: Committee of Inquiry appointed
sections.summary: Minister Iswaran appointed a Committee of Inquiry to look into the incident given broader national cybersecurity implications.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Given the broader national cybersecurity implications, Minister Iswaran has appointed a Committee of Inquiry (COI) to look into this incident.

sections.label: Review of cyber safeguards
sections.summary: A thorough review of the robustness of cyber safeguards of key IT systems will be conducted.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: At the same time, we will be conducting a thorough review of the robustness of the cyber safeguards of our key IT systems.

sections.label: Patients' and PM's records accessed
sections.summary: Personal particulars of 1.5 million patients and medication records of 160,000 patients were illegally accessed, and Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong's records were targeted.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Third, the personal particulars of 1.5 million patients, including the outpatient dispensed medication records of 160,000 patients, were illegally accessed and copied.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Fourth, Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong's records were specifically and repeatedly targeted.

sections.label: Attackers evaded detection, copied data
sections.summary: Attackers evaded SingHealth network security tools, gained access to database servers, and copied data overseas between 27 June and 4 July.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: The attackers had evaded detection by the SingHealth network security tools, moved stealthily through the system, eventually gained access to the database servers storing SingHealth's patient records, and copied the data to servers hosted overseas on 27 June to 4 July.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Based on the logs, two types of data were illegally accessed – personal particulars, including the name, NRIC number, address, gender, race and date of birth of 1.5 million patients, and the outpatient dispensed medication records of 160,000 patients.

sections.label: COI report and attribution
sections.summary: The attack fits known APT groups but no public attribution will be made; the COI will report by 31 December 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: The attack fits the profile of certain known APT groups but, as I have said earlier, for national security reasons, we will not be making any specific public attribution.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The COI will establish the events and contributing factors leading to the cyberattack and the incident response.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The COI will submit its report by 31 December 2018.

sections.label: CSA designating all CII
sections.summary: CSA is implementing the Act's provisions and will designate all CII by end of 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: CSA is currently implementing the provisions of the Act and will designate all CII by the end of 2018.

sections.label: Pause on new systems lifted
sections.summary: The pause on new systems was lifted on 3 August, the previous Friday.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The pause on new systems was lifted on 3 August, just Friday last week.

sections.label: MAS directs financial institutions
sections.summary: MAS directed all financial institutions to take further measures to address residual risk, as announced on 24 July.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: To address any residual risk, the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) has directed all financial institutions to take further measures, as announced in its press statement on 24 July.

sections.label: Agencies' measures after SingHealth cyberattack
sections.summary: Since the SingHealth cyberattack, agencies have heightened IT monitoring and strengthened identity authentication.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Since the SingHealth cyberattack, agencies have taken further measures, such as heightened monitoring of their IT systems, and strengthening of the identity authentication process.

sections.label: Reporting incidents and data breaches
sections.summary: Individuals may contact SingCERT for cybersecurity incidents and the Personal Data Protection Commission for data breaches.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Individuals may also contact SingCERT to report a cybersecurity incident, and the Personal Data Protection Commission to lodge reports of personal data breaches under the Personal Data Protection Act.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: We will get to the bottom of this incident, learn from it and further strengthen Government IT systems.

sections.label: Government securing public sector IT systems
sections.summary: The Government will learn from the cyberattack, secure IT systems and databases, and uphold public trust.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The Government takes with utmost seriousness its responsibility of ensuring the security of public sector IT systems and databases.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: We will learn from this cyberattack, implement measures to better secure our IT systems and databases, and uphold public trust in our systems.

sections.label: Internet Surfing separation imposed
sections.summary: Internet Surfing separation was imposed at midnight on 19 July after evidence of residual risk, and the system was secured as far as possible.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: In fact, as we also elaborated, even as we were doing the work to contain the challenge, as late as on 19 July, there was evidence of some residual risk which had to be dealt with.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: At midnight on 19 July, Internet Surfing separation was then imposed.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The short answer is that we have done everything in our means to secure the system, to detect any residual risk and eliminate it.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: But as I have said several times in the course of my Statement, one can never be sure that we have fully eliminated that risk.

sections.label: Cyberattack confirmation and public disclosure
sections.summary: A cyberattack was confirmed on 10 July, a Police report was lodged two days later, and the public learned of it on 20 July.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: According to the timeline released by the Government, it was confirmed on 10 July that a cyberattack had indeed taken place and, two days later, in fact, a Police report was lodged.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: But the public only got to know about this attack on 20 July.

sections.label: Time between confirmation and disclosure
sections.summary: Between 10 and 20 July, many things were happening and multiple streams of work were carried on at the same time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: On the first question on the time between 10 July when we confirmed that it was a cyberattack and 20 July when we had a press conference and informed the public, I explained in my Statement that between 10 and 20 July, many things were happening and there were multiple streams of work that were carrying on at the same time.

sections.label: Malicious activity and ISS
sections.summary: Malicious activity remained in the data system as late as 19 July, so ISS was imposed that evening, and by 20 July the system was stabilised.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: As we mentioned earlier, as late as 19 July, there was still malicious activity in the data system.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: That is why we had to impose ISS on 19 July evening, so that on 20 July, when we disclosed to the public, we were quite confident that the system had been stabilised.

sections.label: Investing in cybersecurity capabilities
sections.summary: The Government will continue to invest in capabilities to prevent, detect and respond to cyberattacks, including within CSA and the broader system.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: As far as the Government itself is concerned, we are very clear that we have to continue to invest in our ability and capabilities to prevent, detect and respond to any kind of cyberattack.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: So, we have to also ensure that we are able to do so.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: This is why we are investing in cybersecurity, not only in terms of building our capabilities within CSA, but also in the broader system.

sections.label: SingHealth negligence investigation question
sections.summary: A question asks whether the Ministry will investigate any negligence by SingHealth in meeting standards of proactively protecting the CII under the Cyber Security Act.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: For Minister Iswaran, will the Ministry be investigating whether there is any negligence on the part of SingHealth in meeting the standards of proactively protecting the CII under the Cyber Security Act?

sections.label: IHiS SingHealth clusters implement ISS
sections.summary: IHiS, SingHealth and the clusters are reviewing and have just implemented ISS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: IHiS, together with SingHealth and the clusters, are reviewing and we have also just implemented ISS.

sections.label: Protection without ISS, Internet access rights
sections.summary: Together they give significant protection without ISS, and areas like emergency departments may be given Internet access rights.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Taken together, they will provide significant protection without having to resort to ISS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: I would imagine that in a healthcare system where care is quite closely linked to Internet access in some areas, for example, emergency departments and so on, it may be critical, and these are the areas which are more likely to be given certain rights for Internet access.

sections.label: COI scope and private sector systems
sections.summary: The COI's Terms of Reference focus on this incident to produce insights and recommendations for the public sector and healthcare.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Can the Minister for Communications and Information probably share a bit more about the private sector IT systems and, in particular, whether there are any public sector databases which potentially have systemic risk impact on Singapore and Singaporeans in particular?

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The COI's Terms of Reference have been scoped to focus on this incident because if we scope it too wide, then you will lose the value of setting up such a Committee, which is really to go deep, understand what the issues were and then to come up with valuable insights and recommendations which we can apply across the public sector and, specifically, in the healthcare system.

sections.label: CII sectors designated under Cyber Security Act
sections.summary: Sectors like energy and water hold databases deemed CIIs and are designated and governed by CSA under the Cyber Security Act.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: There are others like energy, water and so on.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: And each of these sectors has computer systems that may be within the public sector or in the private sector, but by virtue of the functions they perform, the databases they hold, they are deemed to be CIIs and, therefore, they will be designated and governed as such by CSA, by the rules and provisions under the Cyber Security Act.

sections.label: APT profile, no public attribution
sections.summary: The attack fits known APT groups' profile, but no specific public attribution will be made for national security reasons.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The attack fits the profile of certain known APT groups, but, for national security reasons, we will not be making any specific public attribution.

sections.label: Diagnose problem, consider court attribution
sections.summary: The problem must be diagnosed and steps taken, and if the COI enables attribution for court action, that will be considered.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: What is essential is that we diagnose the problem clearly and take the appropriate steps.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: And if, in the process of the COI deliberations, specific attribution can be made in a manner where action can subsequently be taken up in a Court of law, we will certainly consider that course of action.

sections.label: SMS alerts and 2FA
sections.summary: Suggestions were raised about SMS alerts for NRIC misuse, while transactions with banks, financial institutions and sensitive Government e-transactions have 2FAs.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: And there are some suggestions whether an SMS alert can be sent to them if, let us say, their NRIC details were being used, for example, to open certain accounts or be involved in certain financial transaction.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: That is why, in my Statement, I try to explain why Singaporeans in general and elderly residents, in particular, can draw some comfort from the fact that transactions that involve banks, financial institutions and those involved in sensitive Government e-transactions all have 2FAs.

sections.label: Resetting NRIC-based accounts
sections.summary: Residents should reset accounts where they used their IC number as ID or password and review that exposure.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: So, what we can explain to our residents in general is that the system that is in place is a secure one.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: But what might be prudent for them to do is, where they have got accounts, where they have already set them up and they have used their IC number particularly as an ID, or in some cases, people even use their NRIC as the password, they should reset and ensure that they have thoroughly reviewed this kind of exposure.

sections.label: Action against national security threats
sections.summary: Legislation allows action against a specific actor or individual found to have posed a threat to national security.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: If we can find a specific actor or individual who has posed a threat to our national security, then we also have legislation that allows us to take action against such individuals.

sections.label: Extracting lessons and recommendations
sections.summary: The exercise aims to extract lessons and recommendations usable within the public sector, CII sectors and other private sector operators.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: In fact, that is the objective of the exercise.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: We want to make sure that whatever the findings are, we are able to extract the lessons and recommendations which can then be used not just within the public sector or within the CII sectors but for other private sector operators because there is a general concern about security.

sections.label: Contemporaneous Police investigation
sections.summary: The second point concerns the contemporaneous Police investigation.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The second point is on the contemporaneous Police investigation.

sections.label: Police, COI and PDPC streams
sections.summary: The Police will take reference from COI deliberations, and a third stream is a report lodged with the Personal Data Protection Commission.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: But the Police will also take reference from any deliberations that take place in the COI.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: And I would add that there is a third stream, because there was also a report lodged with the Personal Data Protection Commission.

sections.label: Deterrence capability and public understanding
sections.summary: The speaker states Singapore has conviction and capability to deter attacks, will build capability where lacking, and says Singaporeans must understand defences cannot be foolproof.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Because we have conviction that we can deter, and we have the capability.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: And where we do not, we will build it, and we will find ways to strengthen our systems so that we can resist such attacks.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: And as far as this effort is concerned, it is also important that even as we do this, it is important that, psychologically, not just this House, but Singaporeans at large, understand that it cannot be foolproof.
